about.title: Hermosa Beach Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Hermosa Beach packs a lot of traffic into a small beach town, and that shows up in the numbers: 45 injury collisions and 55 people hurt in the most recent reporting year, with Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. seeing the heaviest reports. Pacific Coast Highway, Hermosa Avenue, Pier Avenue, and Manhattan Avenue carry a lot of that traffic, mixing cars with cyclists, scooters, and pedestrians headed to the pier or the beach path. If you were injured in one of these collisions, what happens in the days right after matters. Photos, witness contacts, and medical records tend to fade or disappear fast, and insurance adjusters often call quickly hoping for a recorded statement before you've had time to think. LawProactive doesn't practice law ourselves — we simply connect injured people with an independent attorney in our network who can look at what happened and explain your options at no upfront cost.
commonInjuries: Cuts, bruising, and soft tissue trauma

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before You Talk to an Insurer

items.title: California's Clock Is Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a car accident lawsuit in California, but claims against a government entity can require notice in as little as six months. Waiting to see how you feel can cost you the ability to pursue a claim at all.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Work Against You
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, meaning even if you're found partly responsible, you can still recover a reduced share of damages. But early statements to an insurer — especially recorded ones — are often used to inflate your share of blame.

items.title: No Cap Means Your Losses Aren't Boxed In
items.desc: California places no limit on non-economic damages like pain and suffering in most car accident cases. An attorney can help make sure those losses are properly documented rather than minimized by an adjuster's quick offer.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurers sometimes use those statements to shift blame onto you under California's comparative fault rules. An independent attorney can advise you on what, if anything, to say.

items.question: What if my crash happened near the Hermosa Beach Pier or on Pier Avenue during a busy weekend?
items.answer: Busy corridors like Pier Avenue and Hermosa Avenue see a mix of cars, cyclists, and pedestrians, which can make fault determinations more complicated. Preserving photos, witness information, and any available surveillance footage quickly can make a real difference. An attorney can help gather this evidence before it's lost.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim after a car accident in Hermosa Beach?
items.answer: In most cases, California gives you two years from the date of the accident to file a lawsuit. If a government vehicle or road defect was involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months for a claim notice. Because deadlines vary by circumstance, it's worth discussing your specific situation with an attorney soon after the crash.
